scripts.build:v1-root-generator: cd services/backend-go && mkdir -p bin && go build -trimpath -o ./bin/ ./cmd/treasury-worker ./cmd/treasury-lifecycle
scripts.test:v1-root-generator: cd services/backend-go && go test -race ./internal/treasury/... && node --experimental-strip-types --test testsupport/treasury-reference.test.ts
scripts.test:v1-treasury: npm run test:v1-treasury-contracts && npm run test:v1-root-generator
scripts.check:interfaces: python3 spec/generate_v1_interfaces.py --check && npm run build:contracts && python3 spec/generate_v1_artifact_manifest.py --check
scripts.test:ci-gates: node --test tools/check-v1-ci-tracks.test.mjs tools/robinhood-rpc-compat-proxy.test.mjs tools/verify-v1-build-inputs.test.mjs && npm run check:tracks
scripts.build:offchain: make -C services/backend-go build && npm --prefix deployments run build
scripts.test:offchain: make -C services/backend-go test && npm --prefix deployments test
scripts.build: npm run check:boundary && npm run build:contracts && npm run check:fixtures && npm run check:product-artifacts && npm run check:backend-contracts && npm run build:offchain && npm run build:web
scripts.test: npm run check:boundary && npm run test:spec && npm run test:contracts && npm run check:fixtures && npm run check:interfaces && npm run check:product-artifacts && npm run test:ci-gates && npm run check:backend-contracts && npm run test:offchain && npm run test:web
